use_case_summary: AmberBridge wants to automate triage for their D2C support org. Primary flow: inbound ticket/email -> concise 2-3 line summary -> 1-3 suggested tags + recommended macro (pre-filled fields) -> agent reviews and triggers macro to run fulfillment calls. Secondary: agent-assist snippets for suggested responses and next-best-actions. Must integrate with Zendesk triggers and Freshdesk workflows; need low false-positive tag assignments and easy human override.
ops_constraints: Peak loads during flash-sales — periodic spikes up to 3x baseline for 2-6 hours. Cannot queue suggestions beyond 15s; prefer warm model instances (dedicated or pinned) for top-tier SKU. Want ability to route EU customer tickets to EU-resident compute for compliance.
recent_risks: Procurement flag: vendor SOC2/ISO docs required; Legal wants explicit clause for EU data processing. SE notes potential integration gap for older Zendesk legacy macros — may require lightweight adapter.
deal_notes: Pricing sensitivity around POC costs — offered capped POC credit for first month. Suggested Dedicated pilot for critical tag inference and hosted API fallback for long-tail categories. Maya to prepare POC runbook; Jordan to confirm procurement timeline.
customer_feedback: Ops lead: "Summaries were concise — liked the 2-line TL;DR. Tagging suggestions hit most obvious tickets but struggled with ambiguous wording (returns vs exchanges)."
final_comment: Good fit for Redwood's smart routing + caching story. Emphasize demo of on-failure fallback and audit logs in next call. Prioritize EU residency answers for Legal.
